name: Button
doc: A push button (`kubuno_controls::buttons::Button` replica).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The label (the replica's `text` field, set directly through `Deref`).

properties.name: Variant
properties.doc: The button's visual weight — filled accent, bordered, ghost, text-only, or danger.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The button's height and horizontal padding.

properties.name: Icon
properties.doc: A leading icon glyph name from the shared icon set.

properties.name: Loading
properties.doc: Replaces the content with a spinning ring and disables the button.

events.name: OnClick
events.doc: Raised when the button is activated (pointer click or Space/Enter).

name: Switch
doc: A toggle switch (`kubuno_controls::buttons::CheckBox`-backed replica).

properties.name: On
properties.doc: The switch's checked state.

properties.name: Label
properties.doc: The text to the switch's right.

properties.name: Description
properties.doc: A secondary line under the label, `text-xs text-text-secondary`.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The track/thumb size.

events.name: OnToggled
events.doc: Raised when the switch's checked state changes.

name: TextField
doc: A single-line text input (`kubuno_controls::text::TextBox` replica).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The field's content.

properties.name: Placeholder
properties.doc: Shown in place of an empty value.

properties.name: Invalid
properties.doc: Turns the border and the focus outline to the danger colour.

events.name: OnChanged
events.doc: Raised when the text changes (typing, paste, programmatic edit).

name: Card
doc: A titled surface (`kubuno_ui::containers::Card`, wraps a `Panel`).

properties.name: Title
properties.doc: The header title; empty hides the header band.

properties.name: Subtitle
properties.doc: The secondary line under the title.

properties.name: Dense
properties.doc: Tighter header/footer/body padding and a body-size title.

properties.name: Flush
properties.doc: No body padding — for a table or list that must bleed to the card's edges.

properties.name: Surface
properties.doc: The card's ground: the Kubuno card, the console's current `Layer` look (`on_layer`), or the card lifted off the page with a shadow (`raised`).

name: Stack
doc: A flow column/row of fixed-extent blocks (`kubuno_ui::containers::Stack`).

properties.name: Direction
properties.doc: The axis blocks run along — the real `FlowDirection` variant names (the design note's friendlier `Horizontal`/`Vertical` aliases are an interpreter-level naming convenience, not modelled yet; see the crate's top-level docs' deviation list).

properties.name: Gap
properties.doc: The space between two blocks, in DIP.

properties.name: Padding
properties.doc: Uniform padding on all four sides, in DIP.

properties.name: Surface
properties.doc: The ground painted under the stack's children.

name: Label
doc: A text run at one of the five type-scale steps (`kubuno_ui::display::Label`).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The label's text.

properties.name: Role
properties.doc: Which step of the web type scale the text is set in.

properties.name: Align
properties.doc: One of the nine alignment cells.

properties.name: Overflow
properties.doc: What happens to text wider than the box: trailing « … », a hard clip, or wrapped onto several lines.

name: LinkLabel
doc: A hyperlink-styled label (`kubuno_ui::display::LinkLabel`).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The link's text.

properties.name: Role
properties.doc: Which step of the web type scale the text is set in.

properties.name: Visited
properties.doc: Marks the link visited (the replica's `LinkVisited`).

events.name: OnClick
events.doc: Raised when the link is activated (pointer click over the text).

name: Badge
doc: A counting / status pill (`kubuno_ui::display::Badge`).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The pill's text.

properties.name: Variant
properties.doc: The pill's tone.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The pill's text size and horizontal padding.

properties.name: Dot
properties.doc: A leading status dot in the variant's saturated hue.

properties.name: MaxWidth
properties.doc: The widest the pill may grow, in DIP, before its text ellipsizes inside it. `0` means no cap.

name: Icon
doc: A vector glyph from the shared icon set (`kubuno_ui::display::Icon`).

properties.name: Name
properties.doc: The glyph's name, from the shared icon set. An unrecognised name paints the missing-glyph box.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The glyph box's side, in DIP.

name: Separator
doc: A hairline rule (`kubuno_ui::display::Separator`).

properties.name: Orientation
properties.doc: Which way the rule runs.

name: Spinner
doc: An indeterminate activity ring (`kubuno_ui::feedback::Spinner`).

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The ring's outer box.

name: ProgressBar
doc: A determinate or indeterminate progress track (`kubuno_ui::range::ProgressBar`).

properties.name: Min
properties.doc: The range's lower bound.

properties.name: Max
properties.doc: The range's upper bound.

properties.name: Value
properties.doc: The current value, clamped to `Min..=Max`.

properties.name: Indeterminate
properties.doc: Unknown progress: a travelling sliver instead of a fill (the replica's `Marquee` style).

properties.name: Label
properties.doc: A header line above the track; empty shows no header.

properties.name: ShowValue
properties.doc: Shows the rounded percentage on the header line.

properties.name: Variant
properties.doc: The fill's colour. `Auto` goes amber then red past the design system's own quota thresholds.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The track's thickness.

name: Callout
doc: An inline severity banner (`kubuno_ui::feedback::Callout`).

properties.name: Body
properties.doc: The callout's text.

properties.name: Title
properties.doc: A bold first line above the body; empty renders body only.

properties.name: Variant
properties.doc: The callout's severity — tints the ground and the glyph.

properties.name: Dismissible
properties.doc: Adds a close button.

properties.name: ShowIcon
properties.doc: Shows the severity glyph.

properties.name: ActionLabel
properties.doc: The single inline action's label ("Réessayer", "Configurer"…); empty shows no action.

events.name: OnAction
events.doc: Raised when the inline action is activated.

events.name: OnDismiss
events.doc: Raised when the close button is activated (only when `Dismissible`).

name: EmptyState
doc: The centred « there is nothing here » block (`kubuno_ui::feedback::EmptyState`).

properties.name: Icon
properties.doc: The medallion's glyph name, from the shared icon set.

properties.name: Title
properties.doc: The block's title.

properties.name: Description
properties.doc: A secondary line under the title; empty shows none.

properties.name: Variant
properties.doc: Why the area is empty — only `FirstUse` gets a primary-styled main action.

properties.name: Compact
properties.doc: Halves the vertical breathing room, for a small card.

properties.name: ActionLabel
properties.doc: The main action's label; empty shows no main action.

properties.name: SecondaryActionLabel
properties.doc: The secondary action's label; empty shows no secondary action.

events.name: OnAction
events.doc: Raised when the main action is activated.

events.name: OnSecondaryAction
events.doc: Raised when the secondary action is activated.

name: IconButton
doc: A round icon-only button (`kubuno_ui::buttons::IconButton` replica).

properties.name: Icon
properties.doc: A curated glyph key (`check`, `close`, `trash`, `search`, `plus`, `help`, `chevron-up`/`chevron-down`/`chevron-right`, `caret-down`, `more-vertical`); unrecognised or empty falls back to a generic "more" glyph.

properties.name: Diameter
properties.doc: The circle's diameter, in DIP (the header's own controls are 36; the waffle's pencil is 40).

properties.name: Glyph
properties.doc: The icon's size inside the circle, in DIP.

properties.name: Filled
properties.doc: A resting tint (`surface-2`) instead of no background at rest — the waffle pencil's look.

events.name: OnClick
events.doc: Raised when the button is activated (pointer click or Space/Enter).

name: CheckBox
doc: A two-state check box (`kubuno_ui::buttons::CheckBox` replica, `Appearance::Normal`).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The label.

properties.name: Description
properties.doc: A secondary line under the label.

properties.name: Checked
properties.doc: The check box's checked state.

events.name: OnCheckedChanged
events.doc: Raised when the checked state changes (a completed click).

name: RadioButton
doc: A mutually-exclusive option (`kubuno_ui::buttons::RadioButton` replica). Selection is not a flag this element owns: it is `SelectedValue == Value`, so several `<RadioButton>` elements bound to the SAME `SelectedValue` path exclude each other with no group registry — see this family's module doc.

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The label.

properties.name: Description
properties.doc: A secondary line under the label.

properties.name: Value
properties.doc: This option's own value token.

properties.name: Group
properties.doc: Advisory grouping id: not enforced by the interpreter (exclusion comes from the shared `SelectedValue` binding alone), but used together with `Value` to seed a stable `FocusId` when the element carries no `x:Name` — read as a plain literal, never as a `{Binding …}`, since only stability across frames matters here.

properties.name: SelectedValue
properties.doc: The group's current value, typically `{Binding …, Mode=TwoWay}`; this option paints selected when it resolves to the same text as `Value`.

events.name: OnCheckedChanged
events.doc: Raised with the new `SelectedValue` when this option is chosen.

name: Slider
doc: A drag-to-set range control (`kubuno_ui::range::Slider`, `@ui/RangeSlider` replica).

properties.name: Min
properties.doc: The lowest reachable value (`TrackBar::Minimum`).

properties.name: Max
properties.doc: The highest reachable value (`TrackBar::Maximum`).

properties.name: Value
properties.doc: The current value, folded into `[Min, Max]`.

properties.name: Step
properties.doc: One keyboard/small step (`TrackBar::SmallChange`).

properties.name: LargeStep
properties.doc: One page step (`TrackBar::LargeChange`).

events.name: OnValueChanged
events.doc: Raised on every value change while dragging.

name: NumericField
doc: A numeric spinner (`kubuno_ui::range::NumericField`, `@ui/NumberInput` replica). Only the step buttons are interactive today; see this family's module doc for why free-text typing is deferred.

properties.name: Min
properties.doc: The lowest reachable value (`NumericUpDown::Minimum`).

properties.name: Max
properties.doc: The highest reachable value (`NumericUpDown::Maximum`).

properties.name: Value
properties.doc: The current value, folded into `[Min, Max]`.

properties.name: Step
properties.doc: One spin-button step (`NumericUpDown::Increment`).

properties.name: Invalid
properties.doc: Turns the border and the focus outline to the danger colour.

events.name: OnValueChanged
events.doc: Raised when a step button changes the value.

name: Option
doc: A Dropdown/ComboBox item — data only, never painted on its own.

properties.name: Value
properties.doc: The option's value — matched against a Dropdown/ComboBox's bound SelectedValue.

properties.name: Label
properties.doc: The option's displayed text; defaults to Value when omitted.

name: TextArea
doc: A multiline text input (`kubuno_ui::text::TextArea`, the multiline case of TextField).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The field's content.

properties.name: Placeholder
properties.doc: Shown in place of an empty value.

properties.name: Invalid
properties.doc: Turns the border and the focus outline to the danger colour.

events.name: OnChanged
events.doc: Raised when the text changes (typing, paste, programmatic edit).

name: SearchField
doc: A search pill (`kubuno_ui::text::SearchField`) — a leading glyph and a clear "x" shown while it holds text.

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The query text.

properties.name: Placeholder
properties.doc: Shown in place of an empty value.

events.name: OnChanged
events.doc: Raised when the text changes (typing, paste, the clear ✕, Escape).

name: MaskedField
doc: A field governed by a WinForms mask (`kubuno_ui::text::MaskedField`, e.g. "00/00/0000").

properties.name: Mask
properties.doc: The WinForms mask pattern (e.g. `00/00/0000`); applied once and re-applied whenever this value changes.

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The field's visible content (literals, entered characters, the prompt glyph).

properties.name: Invalid
properties.doc: Turns the border and the focus outline to the danger colour — a natural driver is `!mask_completed()`, left to the caller.

events.name: OnChanged
events.doc: Raised when the masked content changes.

name: Dropdown
doc: A selector with a floating list (`kubuno_ui::editors::Dropdown`) — items are <Option Value=".." Label=".."/> children.

properties.name: SelectedValue
properties.doc: The selected <Option>'s Value, or empty for no selection — see the family's module doc.

properties.name: Placeholder
properties.doc: Shown in the trigger when nothing is selected.

properties.name: Variant
properties.doc: The trigger's look: a bordered field, or borderless (for a toolbar).

properties.name: ItemsSource
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` to a row list (`crate::binding::Value::List`); each row becomes one `<Option>`, `DisplayMember`/`ValueMember` naming which row field is the label/value, re-read every frame. Static `<Option Value=".." Label=".."/>` children still work and are used as long as this either names no binding or the binding is unset/not a list.

properties.name: DisplayMember
properties.doc: The row field shown as each bound option's label.

properties.name: ValueMember
properties.doc: The row field matched against SelectedValue.

events.name: OnChanged
events.doc: Raised with the new SelectedValue when the selection changes.

name: ComboBox
doc: A select-only combo box with a floating list (`kubuno_ui::lists::ComboBox`) — items are <Option Value=".." Label=".."/> children.

properties.name: SelectedValue
properties.doc: The selected <Option>'s Value, or empty for no selection — see the family's module doc.

properties.name: ItemsSource
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` to a row list (`crate::binding::Value::List`); each row becomes one `<Option>`, `DisplayMember`/`ValueMember` naming which row field is the label/value, re-read every frame. Static `<Option Value=".." Label=".."/>` children still work and are used as long as this either names no binding or the binding is unset/not a list.

properties.name: DisplayMember
properties.doc: The row field shown as each bound option's label.

properties.name: ValueMember
properties.doc: The row field matched against SelectedValue.

events.name: OnChanged
events.doc: Raised with the new SelectedValue when the selection changes.

name: DatePicker
doc: A date field with a floating calendar (`kubuno_ui::datetime::DatePicker`).

properties.name: Date
properties.doc: The selected date, ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

properties.name: Format
properties.doc: The culture's long/short date pattern, or a time-of-day field with a spinner.

properties.name: Invalid
properties.doc: Turns the border and the focus ring to the danger colour.

events.name: OnChanged
events.doc: Raised with the new Date (ISO 8601) when the value changes.

name: ColorField
doc: A colour swatch trigger (`kubuno_ui::color::ColorField`). GAP: its floating ColorPicker panel is not wired — see the family module doc; a host reacts to OnClick itself.

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The swatch's colour, as a `#rrggbb` hex literal.

events.name: OnClick
events.doc: Raised when the swatch is activated — a host shows its own colour editor in response.

name: Panel
doc: A box that places its children by Dock or Anchor (`kubuno_ui::containers::Panel`).

properties.name: Padding
properties.doc: Uniform padding on all four sides, in DIP.

properties.name: Surface
properties.doc: The ground painted under the panel's children.

name: GroupBox
doc: A titled frame around one child (`kubuno_ui::containers::GroupBox`).

properties.name: Title
properties.doc: The caption drawn in the frame's top band.

properties.name: Padding
properties.doc: Uniform padding on all four sides, in DIP.

name: ScrollArea
doc: Scrolls whatever its one child paints past its edges (`kubuno_ui::containers::ScrollArea`).

properties.name: Corner
properties.doc: The region's rounded-corner radius; 0 for a square region.

name: Splitter
doc: Two panes separated by a draggable band (`kubuno_ui::containers::Splitter`).

properties.name: Orientation
properties.doc: `Vertical`: a vertical BAR, panes side by side. `Horizontal`: a horizontal bar, panes stacked.

properties.name: Distance
properties.doc: Pane 1's extent (width for Vertical, height for Horizontal), in DIP; bindable two-way — dragging the bar (mouse or, once focused, the keyboard: the two arrows along the split axis, Home/End, Shift for a larger step) writes the new value back.

events.name: OnDistanceChanged
events.doc: Raised when a drag or a keyboard move changes Distance.

name: TabItem
doc: One page of a `<Tabs>` strip: a header and a body. Valid only as a direct `<Tabs>` child.

properties.name: Header
properties.doc: The tab's strip label.

name: Tabs
doc: An underline tab strip (`kubuno_ui::navigation::Tabs` + `TabsController`), pages `<TabItem>`.

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.doc: The selected tab's index.

events.name: OnSelectionChanged
events.doc: Raised when the selected tab changes (click or keyboard).

name: BreadcrumbItem
doc: One segment of a `<Breadcrumb>` trail. Valid only as a direct `<Breadcrumb>` child.

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The segment's label.

events.name: OnClick
events.doc: Raised when this segment is activated (it is not the trail's last/current segment).

name: Breadcrumb
doc: A path trail (`kubuno_ui::navigation::Breadcrumb`), segments `<BreadcrumbItem>`.

properties.name: RootChevron
properties.doc: Reserves a leading chevron for a caller-drawn home icon.

name: ToolbarItem
doc: One command of a `<Toolbar>`. Valid only as a direct `<Toolbar>` child.

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The command's caption (icon-only when empty).

properties.name: Icon
properties.doc: A leading icon glyph name from the shared icon set.

events.name: OnClick
events.doc: Raised when this command is activated.

name: Toolbar
doc: A command bar (`kubuno_ui::navigation::Toolbar`), commands `<ToolbarItem>`.

properties.name: Band
properties.doc: Paints its own `layer_background` band under the commands.

name: AccordionSection
doc: One collapsible group of a `<Accordion>`. Valid only as a direct `<Accordion>` child.

properties.name: Header
properties.doc: The section's title.

properties.name: Open
properties.doc: Whether the section starts expanded.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.doc: Renders muted and stays collapsed.

events.name: OnToggled
events.doc: Raised when this section's open state changes.

name: Accordion
doc: A stack of collapsible groups (`kubuno_ui::feedback::Accordion`), sections `<AccordionSection>`.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The header/panel padding scale.

name: Step
doc: One step of a `<Stepper>` trail. Valid only as a direct `<Stepper>` child.

properties.name: Label
properties.doc: The step's caption.

properties.name: Description
properties.doc: A secondary line under the label.

properties.name: Status
properties.doc: An explicit status; empty derives it from the position relative to the current step.

properties.name: Optional
properties.doc: Appends an « (optional) » marker.

name: Stepper
doc: A wizard's progress spine (`kubuno_ui::feedback::Stepper`), steps `<Step>`.

properties.name: CurrentIndex
properties.doc: The step the user is on, by index.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.doc: Which way the trail runs.

properties.name: AllowForward
properties.doc: Whether a step past the current one may be clicked.

events.name: OnStepSelected
events.doc: Raised when the user picks a reachable step.

name: ListBox
doc: A scrolling list of strings (`kubuno_ui::lists::ListBox` replica).

properties.name: SelectionMode
properties.doc: How many rows can be selected at once, and how a click combines with Ctrl/Shift.

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.doc: The anchor of the selection (`-1` = none); bindable two-way.

properties.name: ItemsSource
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` to a row list (`crate::binding::Value::List`); each row's `Text` field becomes one row's label, re-read every frame. Static `<Item Text=".."/>` children still work and are used as long as this either names no binding or the binding is unset/not a list.

events.name: OnSelectionChanged
events.doc: Raised when the selection changes (a pointer click).

name: CheckedListBox
doc: A `ListBox` whose rows carry a check box (`kubuno_ui::lists::CheckedListBox` replica).

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.doc: The single selected row (`-1` = none); bindable two-way.

properties.name: CheckOnClick
properties.doc: Toggle a row's check on a plain click instead of requiring the check well.

properties.name: ItemsSource
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` to a row list (`crate::binding::Value::List`); each row's `Text` field becomes one row's label, re-read every frame (all unchecked — a bound row's check state is not modelled, see this family's report). Static `<Item Text=".."/>` children still work and are used as long as this either names no binding or the binding is unset/not a list.

events.name: OnSelectionChanged
events.doc: Raised when the selected row changes.

events.name: OnCheckedChanged
events.doc: Raised when a row's check state toggles.

name: ListView
doc: A columned, virtualised row list (`kubuno_ui::views::ListView` replica, Details mode).

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.doc: The anchor of the selection (`-1` = none); bindable two-way.

properties.name: MultiSelect
properties.doc: Allow more than one selected row.

properties.name: ItemsSource
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` to a row list (`crate::binding::Value::List`); with `<Column>` children declared, each row's field named by a column's own `Binding` (its bare path, e.g. `Name` for `{Binding Name}`) becomes that column's cell text for that row, re-read every frame. A column with no `Binding` reads no field (an empty cell for every bound row). Static `<Item Text=".."/>` children still work and are used as long as this either names no binding or the binding is unset/not a list; `<Column>` children always declare the columns themselves either way.

events.name: OnSelectionChanged
events.doc: Raised when the selection changes (a pointer click).

events.name: OnActivate
events.doc: Raised on a double-click on a row.

name: TreeView
doc: An indented, expandable node tree (`kubuno_ui::views::TreeView` replica).

properties.name: SelectedPath
properties.doc: The selected node, as dot-joined child indices (`"0.2.1"`, `""` = none); bindable two-way.

properties.name: MultiSelect
properties.doc: Allow more than one selected node.

properties.name: ItemsSource
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` to a row list (`crate::binding::Value::List`); each row's `Text` field becomes one FLAT, top-level, always-childless node — `Value::List` has no nested-row shape, so a bound tree is one level deep (see this family's report); nest with static `<Item Text="..">..</Item>` children for a real hierarchy. Static children still work and are used as long as this either names no binding or the binding is unset/not a list.

events.name: OnSelectionChanged
events.doc: Raised when the selected node changes.

events.name: OnActivate
events.doc: Raised on a double-click on a node.

name: DataTable
doc: A full data grid — toolbar, sortable columns, pagination (`kubuno_ui::tables::DataTable` replica).

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.doc: The anchor of the selection (`-1` = none); bindable two-way.

properties.name: ItemsSource
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` to a row list (`crate::binding::Value::List`), the shape `admin_users.rs::table()` already hand-builds; each row's field named by a column's own `Binding` (its bare path, e.g. `Name` for `{Binding Name}` — the same name that column's id/sort-key already uses) becomes that column's cell text for that row, re-read every frame. Without this, the table declares its columns with static `<Column Header=".." Binding=".."/>` children and starts with zero rows.

events.name: OnSelectionChanged
events.doc: Raised when the selected row changes.

events.name: OnRowActivated
events.doc: Raised on a double-click on a row.

events.name: OnSortChanged
events.doc: Raised when a sortable column header is clicked.

name: MonthCalendar
doc: A one-month date grid (`kubuno_ui::datetime::MonthCalendar` replica).

properties.name: SelectedDate
properties.doc: The picked day, as an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` date (`""` = none); bindable two-way.

events.name: OnDateSelected
events.doc: Raised when a day is picked (a click on a selectable day).

name: Item
doc: A static list entry — a row of `<ListBox>`/`<CheckedListBox>`/`<ListView>`, or (nested under itself) one node of a `<TreeView>`'s tree. Read directly off the parsed XML by the parent's `build` (see this file's module doc); never reached through `Props::build_children`, so it builds an inert placeholder. Accepts any attribute name, not just `Text`: a `<ListView>`/`<DataTable>` row's other columns are read the same way, by an attribute named exactly like that column's own `Binding` field (see `static_item_rows`).

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The row's (or tree node's) label.

name: Column
doc: A static column declaration — a `<ListView>`/`<DataTable>` child. Read directly off the parsed XML by the parent's `build` (see this file's module doc); never reached through `Props::build_children`, so it builds an inert placeholder.

properties.name: Header
properties.doc: The column's header label.

properties.name: Binding
properties.doc: A `{Binding Path}` naming the row field this column shows — accepted (and used to derive the column's stable id) but not resolved per row until `ItemsSource` is (see this file's module doc).

properties.name: Width
properties.doc: The column's width, in DIP.
